ios.desc:
Vicoa (Vicoa Code Anywhere) is the best agentic IDE for running Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents in parallel on any device. Start coding on your laptop, continue seamlessly on your phone or tablet, and never miss an important moment when your AI agent needs your input.

Vicoa was built for developers who want to stay in flow even when they step away from their desk. Whether you’re waiting for a build, running a long task, or need to approve an agent’s next step, Vicoa keeps you connected.

Key Features:

• Continue Claude Code sessions across laptop, mobile, and tablet

• Get instant alerts when your AI agent needs clarification or has finished a task

• Pick up right where you left off, even if your laptop is running a long process

• See live updates from your agent in real time

• Simple setup – connect once and stay in sync

How It Works:

1. Install the Vicoa CLI on your terminal
2. Sign in to authorize the terminal
3. Start a Claude Code session as usual and switch between devices at any time

Perfect for developers who:

• Step away from their desk but want to stay productive

• Run long-running AI tasks that need occasional input

• Work flexibly across laptop, tablet, and phone

• Want to code from the couch, coffee shop, or on the go

Vicoa is your companion for Claude Code and Codex – designed to keep you in control and your workflow uninterrupted, wherever you are.

Download Vicoa and start vibe coding anywhere anytime!


Terms of Use: https://vicoa.ai/terms

Privacy Policy: https://vicoa.ai/privacy

We value your feedback and suggestions. 

Connect with us:

Email: hi@vicoa.ai

quotes.text:
Hey all, Nick here. I am building Vicoa (Vibe Code Anywhere) https://vibecodeanywhere.com, a tool for you to use Claude Code (and Codex) anywhere.

With Vicoa you can:

- Run a regular Claude Code session from terminal

- Pick up the same session on mobile or tablet

- Get push notifications when Claude Code needs your input

- Keep everything in sync across devices

Demo video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZBpNzqqLYmg

I built this because I kept hitting the same pain point with Claude Code: you have to sit and babysit it. Often Claude stops mid-flow waiting for input. If I stepped away — even just for coffee — I’d come back later to find progress stalled and needs my input. So I built the Vicoa.

You can install it with a simple command: `pip install vicoa && vicoa`

Download iOS App here: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6751626168

This is an early version. Looking forward to your feedback and comments.
